reproducibility.monitor_program:
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import importlib.util,tempfile,json,sys,io,contextlib
from unittest.mock import patch
skill=Path('.agents/skills/joso-jdrt-runner/scripts').resolve()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('review_monitor',skill/'choice_monitor.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
results=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='choice_monitor_forward_review_') as temp:
    for case in ['normal_completed','implementation_SHA','input_manifest_SHA','READY_SHA','orphan_RUNNING','collision','population_mismatch','native_Error','check_command_failure']:
        root=Path(temp)/case;root.mkdir();out=root/'06_研究結果/jdrt/goal_20261017';out.mkdir(parents=True)
        ws=root/'ws';folder=ws/'runs/r';folder.mkdir(parents=True);logs=ws/'driver_logs';logs.mkdir()
        inputs=root/'inputs';inputs.mkdir()
        (inputs/'people.csv').write_text('person_id\np\nq\n',encoding='utf-8')
        (inputs/'manifest.json').write_text('{}',encoding='utf-8')
        (folder/'preflight_ready.json').write_text('{}',encoding='utf-8')
        (folder/'sumo_errors.log').write_text('',encoding='utf-8')
        (logs/'r.stderr.log').write_text('',encoding='utf-8')
        (root/'impl.py').write_text('# fixed',encoding='utf-8')
        cfg={'workspace':'ws','protocol':'synthetic_choice'}
        config=root/'04_プログラム/config/jdrt_realtime_choice_v1.json';config.parent.mkdir(parents=True);config.write_text(json.dumps(cfg),encoding='utf-8')
        manifest={'protocol':cfg['protocol'],'purpose':'core','run_id':'r','cell_id':'c','pid':999999,'status':'COMPLETED',
                  'input_directory':'inputs','input_manifest_sha256':m.file_sha(inputs/'manifest.json'),
                  'preflight_ready_sha256':m.file_sha(folder/'preflight_ready.json'),'implementation_sha256':{'impl.py':m.file_sha(root/'impl.py')}}
        (folder/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest),encoding='utf-8')
        check={'status':'COMPLETED','pid_alive':False,'error':None,'progress':{'time_sec':1000,'people_states':{'time_limit':2},
               'counts':{k:0 for k in ['teleports','collisions','closed_entry_rows','ambiguous_transitions','missing_vehicle_subscriptions','missing_person_subscriptions']}}}
        expected=[];returncode=0
        if case in ['implementation_SHA','input_manifest_SHA','READY_SHA']:
            target={'implementation_SHA':root/'impl.py','input_manifest_SHA':inputs/'manifest.json','READY_SHA':folder/'preflight_ready.json'}[case]
            target.write_text('changed',encoding='utf-8');expected=['input_or_implementation_or_READY_SHA_mismatch']
        if case=='orphan_RUNNING':check['status']='RUNNING';expected=['orphan_RUNNING']
        if case=='collision':check['progress']['counts']['collisions']=1;expected=['nonzero_collisions']
        if case=='population_mismatch':check['progress']['people_states']['time_limit']=1;expected=['whole_population_accounting_mismatch']
        if case=='native_Error':(folder/'sumo_errors.log').write_text('  Error: synthetic\nWarning: retained\n',encoding='utf-8');expected=['native_SUMO_Error_lines']
        if case=='check_command_failure':returncode=1;expected=['skill_check_command_failure']
        def fake_check(command,cwd,stdout,stderr):
            assert command[-3:]==['check','--run-id','r']
            stdout.write(json.dumps(check).encode());stdout.flush();return SimpleNamespace(returncode=returncode)
        with patch.object(m,'ROOT',root),patch.object(m,'OUT',out),patch.object(m.subprocess,'run',fake_check),patch.object(sys,'argv',['monitor','--run-id','r']),contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            exitcode=m.main()
        files=list(out.glob('監視_*.json'));assert len(files)==1
        report=json.loads(files[0].read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        assert report['anomaly_flags']==expected
        assert exitcode==(1 if expected else 0)
        assert report['formal_validation_or_adoption'] is False
        assert report['input_population_rows']==2
        assert all(p.is_file() and len(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines())==1 for p in [out/'operations.jsonl',logs/'operations.jsonl',logs/'monitoring.jsonl'])
        results.append({'case':case,'status':'PASS','flags':expected,'exit_code':exitcode})
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','check_subprocess':'mocked; no simulation or research CLI called','cases':results},ensure_ascii=True))

limits: No --apply against actual documents or checkpoint; no formal adoption, recovery, new run or SUMO execution.
Full real monitor execution reported by parent was not repeated by this reviewer; monitor artificial checks mock only the check subprocess.
Ordinary sync intentionally does not revalidate all run output data, input artifacts, driver/native logs or certify core adoption.
Caught-exception rollback is verified while restoration writes remain possible; persistent disk errors or machine/process interruption can still require archived-byte recovery.
Operations JSONL appends occur after the display transaction; a logging failure can leave synchronized documents while the command raises. No atomic all-logs guarantee was added.
